serie: Loretta's Church Kitchen: an 81-year-old Iowa church lady cooks the church supper recipes of her little cookbook, one recipe a video, in her farmhouse kitchen and the basement kitchen of her country church
acciones: stirring a pot, sliding a 9x13 pan into the oven, lifting a foil-lined sheet pan out of the oven, spooning syrup over a dish, lifting a lid to check, tasting from a wooden spoon, carrying a covered dish, setting a church supper table
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar
lugares_fijos.sotano: the basement kitchen of Zion country church in Iowa: long folding tables with paper tablecloths, a big old range, steel counters, a row of covered church dishes, a tall window at the top of the wall
lugares_fijos.comedor: the long church fellowship hall table set for a supper: folding tables pushed end to end with paper tablecloths, plain white plates and mismatched cups, a coffee urn at the end

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
